reviews.title: Paid Membership Required!!!
reviews.review_text: You have to pay for a yearly membership to access the color changing features of these light bulbs.
White light is able to light up a room the colored lights barely light up anything

reviews.title: Solid 3 but get one with Bluetooth for easier connection.
reviews.review_text: Its great light, but for long term use there is an issue. the H6003 requires 2.4Ghz wi-fi band to set it up and continue controlling the lights. Your phone is probably on a 5Ghz wifi band. it won't connect to the light or control them after setup if you move your phone back to the faster wi-fi. Each light has to be setup individually. There is no batch change option that I've found in the app.

reviews.title: Software problem
reviews.review_text: I bought this item with the purpose of changing the lights to colors to the rhythm of the music, and it works when I enter the app and press that mode, but when I exit the app, it resets. I bought two of them, and while one works in the app with the music, the other one doesn't. I think it's a software issue. Can you help me with this matter?

reviews.title: Updated review..Nice lights not without with some issues
reviews.review_text: Nice lights nice colors you can group lights in app and group lights with google voice has more control than alexa. Alexa integration of groups doesnt exist. I give it a 8 if it had alexa control as well it's a 7 I'm very happy hopefully they last and don't have to be reset often. Few days later seems that initial app install was fine on iOS secondary phone app installed on android not as well. Android govee app can control lights but can never bring the lights back to a of 2700k white seems like a bug. I'm using android 7 nougat and reinstalled app and still very buggy on android. Looks like product is aimed at the iphone user my wifes iphone works very nice. Google voice and alexa will switch on and offf lights at the last set color. You can change the light color in google home but wont ever be 2700k full brightness . Alexa app is strictly on/off no groups i can see yet. so really need an iphone with govee app to make this unit purr. Hopefully they will work out the kinks or maybe my android is too old I really would just like to be able to tell google these lights go to 2700k full brightness with or and i woud be very pleased . I can tell google to go to green no issue to go red no issue and white but whites not a normal lighting for room. Well i like govee it looks like there is a lot of effort put in this product but it does fall short of the mark they set for the light. I bought 6 for my bedroom and they do work but not without some issues. Its always posibble that ymmmv. Perhaps a new android phone would cure the issue Ill update when something changes.Update....awesome lights my phone was corrupted reformatted phone hover works as it should 5 stars
